description: List published articles from this Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) Taiwan community forum (PTT-style boards for news, sharing, and user-created topics; the largest collection is a news-digest board covering primarily late 2025 to early 2026). To list a specific board, provide BOTH forumName and subForumName (providing only one is rejected). Otherwise pass sort=HOT for recently trending articles (engagement-ranked over a recent time window; may return an empty page when there are no recently posted articles), or omit sort (or sort=LATEST) for the most recent. sort must be HOT or LATEST. Content is truncated; use get_article for full content.
name: list_articles
